coverage.other_conditions: A residential dwelling unit is defined as any primary residence, excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities.
coverage.summary: Applies to landlords of any residential dwelling unit (any primary residence) in Hoboken. Medical/long-term care and detention facilities are excluded. There is no unit-count, building-age or landlord-size threshold.
unverifiable_exemptions: Units that are not a primary residence are outside the definition of residential dwelling unit.

evidence.quoted_span: any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities)

Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.

result.notes: The existing coverage is supported by DX01. requires_unknown_facts is set to false because the ordinance covers ordinary rental dwelling units citywide. The primary-residence limitation is recorded as an unverifiable exemption, because an address lookup cannot confirm whether a unit is used as a primary residence. The medical/long-term care and detention facility exclusions are building-type exclusions; they are kept in other_conditions. No unit-count, construction-date or landlord-size thresholds appear in the text. Preemption by the state FAIR Act is not addressed in DX01, so preemption fields stay null.
